quality_policy.direct_reliable: combat_play + matrix/report match + mismatch_count=0 + Reliable + strict_public_state/identity comparison + valid v0.111 report/trace
quality_policy.direct_estimated: play row matched but report is Estimated or lacks strict Reliable eligibility
quality_policy.mismatch: report exists but match=false or mismatch_count>0; never Reliable
quality_policy.fixture_not_entered_combat: fixture ended at card_reward instead of a combat action; regenerate with the card's owning character/context
quality_policy.choice_fixture_required: card opened an interactive selection; regenerate with a stable select_cards/choice contract
quality_policy.runtime_unavailable: runtime rejected or could not instantiate the card; verify version/model availability before retrying
quality_policy.runtime_timeout: combat action existed but ShadowDiff timed out; Uncalculable
quality_policy.runtime_error: runtime/CLI error; Uncalculable and included in degraded aggregate
quality_policy.non_play: card_reward/card_select/error decision is not a direct combat witness even if a terminal report matches
quality_policy.repeat_verified: report hash must be present in card-direct-repeat-verification.json with verdict=pass; only then is main_reliable_eligible true
